app.name: Timers
app.summary: A kitchen timer you set with +10s, +1m, +10m and +1h, a stopwatch with laps, and a live overview for screen, helper, and Assist voice timers.
app.setting_popup: Show popup when a timer is done
app.setting_popup_hint: Wake the screen and show a dismissible popup over the current page when any screen, helper, or voice timer finishes.
app.setting_opens: Open the timer when it is done
app.setting_opens_hint: If the popup is off, a timer on the screen opens its card when the time is up.
app.part_sound: Ring when a timer is done
app.part_sound_hint: Three beeps every two seconds for a minute, or until you tap Stop.
app.setting_sound_hint: The beeps when a timer is done, on a screen with a speaker.
app.setting_alarm_volume_hint: Minimum speaker volume while a timer rings (0% follows the screen's current volume).
